Breaking: Delhi Traffic Advisory for Dwarka

Delhi Traffic Police has announced traffic regulations in the Dwarka area on 2nd and 3rd September (6 AM to 3 PM) due to heavy traffic arrangements. 

Key roads including Road No. 224, 205, 221, Golf Link Road, and UER-II will be affected.

Commuters are urged to use public transport, follow diversion signs, and allow extra time for travel. Cooperation with traffic personnel is requested.

@DelhiPolice @dtptraffic
